methods.name: Differential Diffusion based VTON
methods.description: Uses a diffusion model to synthesize the try-on result after obtaining the warped garment.

methods.name: PBE
methods.description: Architecture adopted for synthesis network, pretrained on millions of images for image inpainting.

methods.name: Denoising Path
methods.description: Takes the ground truth human image as input.

methods.name: Inpainting Path
methods.description: Utilizes the integrated warped garment into the clothing-agnostic image.

methods.name: Differential Information Tracking Path (DITP)
methods.description: Proposed to replace the simplistic inpainting path to manage denoising and inpainting tasks.

methods.name: Dynamic Semantics Selector
methods.description: Uses self-similarity of garment features to unsupervisedly generate selection masks indicating each channel's semantic group.

methods.name: Group Warping Block
methods.description: Generates flows and attention maps for different channel groups.

methods.name: Disentangled Warping Operation
methods.description: Uses the selection mask and predicted flows and attention maps to deform garment features.

methods.name: Fixed Grouping
methods.description: Evenly divided all channels sequentially without using the Dynamic Semantics Selector
